Higher Education Committee
Tuesday, March 12, 2024
3:00 PM, G-15 Capitol

Minutes

Present: Senator Omar Fateh - Chair, Senator Aric Putnam Vice Chair, Senator Robert D. Farnsworth, Senator Robert J. Kupec,
Senator Erin P. Murphy, Senator Clare Oumou Verbeten, Senator Jason Rarick

Absent: Senator Zach Duckworth

Senator Omar Fateh called the meeting to order at 3:06

Call to order

S.F. 4003: Senator Fateh: Certain higher education provisions technical and policy changes.

Testifiers:

-Nekey Oliver, Director of Government Relations and Community Outreach, Office of Higher Education

-Travis Matthews, Senior Policy Fellows, Opportunity Youth Network

-Nia Deyer, Community Board Co-Chair, Foster Advocates -Ace Goff, Community Board Co-Chair, Foster Advocates
-Ziigwan Frazer, Policy and Advocacy Manager, Foster Advocates

-Hoang Murphy

-Tim Pippert, Executive Director, Augsburg Family Scholars

Senator Fateh moved that S.F. 4003, be laid over.

S.F 4400: Senator Oumou Verbeten: Legacy admissions and admissions based on donor status prohibition.

Testifier:
-Robert McMaster, Vice Provost of Undergraduate Education, University of Minnesota

Senator Oumou Verbeten moved that S.F. 4400, be laid over.

The meeting was adjourned at 4:01pm
